integrity: Analytic calculations are accompanied by independently executable exact symbolic checks of the polynomial identities. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Global zero-curvature-circle uniqueness is proved only for Euclidean-distance weight exponent 4. At noninteger exponents greater than the central transition the result asserts at least one circle, not uniqueness. The known Euclidean-distance weighted disk kernel is an input. The motivating contemporary parameter-regularity manuscript could not be inspected beyond available abstract and technical synopsis; older literature priority remains provisional.
title: First positive-curvature core in Euclidean-distance weighted disk Bergman metrics
